hero.heading: Pioneering the Future of <highlight>AI Skincare</highlight>
hero.paragraph: Cosmetics Finder connects buyers seeking personalized skincare solutions with merchants selling skincare products, powered by AI skin analysis and smart product recommendations.

story.title: Decoding Beauty through Intelligence
story.p1: Consumers struggle to find skincare products suited to their individual skin types and concerns. Traditional e-commerce lacks personalization, leading to poor product choices and wasted spending.
story.p2: Our proprietary AI model analyzes thousands of data points — from ingredient interactions to individual skin phenotypes — to construct a regimen that is unequivocally yours. We believe that clarity is the ultimate luxury.

missionVision.missionDesc: To provide personalized skincare product recommendations based on AI analysis, increasing conversion rates through targeted product matching and merchant tools for product management and sales analytics.
missionVision.visionDesc: A future where trial-and-error is obsolete. We envision a seamlessly integrated digital ecosystem where your biological needs instantly align with perfect product formulations through multi-vendor marketplace growth.

engine.title: The Intelligence Engine
engine.desc: A seamless four-step process engineered to deliver unprecedented accuracy. AI skin analysis processing completes in under 10 seconds.

capabilities.sectionDesc: Everything you need for a personalized skincare journey.

aiSkinAnalysis.title: AI Skin Analysis
aiSkinAnalysis.desc: Upload a photo and get instant insights on your skin type, conditions, and age estimation.

smartRecommendations.title: Smart Recommendations
smartRecommendations.desc: Receive personalized product suggestions matched to your unique skin profile and concerns.

curatedMarketplace.title: Curated Marketplace
curatedMarketplace.desc: Browse thousands of skincare products from trusted brands, filtered by your skin needs.

multiLanguageSupport.title: Multi-Language Support
multiLanguageSupport.desc: Use the platform in English, Myanmar, or Japanese — your language, your choice.

securePrivate.title: Secure & Private
securePrivate.desc: Your data is protected with enterprise-grade security and privacy-first design.

instantResults.title: Instant Results
instantResults.desc: Get AI-powered analysis in under 10 seconds with real-time product matching.

steps.step1Desc: Take or upload a clear facial photo for analysis.
steps.step2Desc: Our model analyzes skin type, condition, and age estimation.
steps.step3Desc: Cross-references ingredient data with your skin profile.
steps.step4Desc: Receive a personalized, optimized skincare routine.
